description: Original quantitative teaching charts. All units are illustrative. The two error-versus-complexity charts are explicitly schematic, not notebook measurements or universal laws.

linearModel.description: Invented one-stop campus delivery records. Distance is in km and duration in minutes. The plotted line is a candidate; a later slide computes the least-squares fit to this excerpt.

fittingComparison.description: Same seven constructed noisy observations in each panel; dashed reference is y=z^2. The line and quadratic are exact least-squares fits. Degree-six polynomial interpolates the data.

biasVariance.description: Constructed equally likely predictions in minutes for one fixed 2 km, two-stop route, whose true mean is 15 min. Each prediction represents retraining on a fresh dataset, not another route. These are not notebook estimates.

complexityErrors.description: Illustrative functions with nonincreasing training error and U-shaped validation error; axes are qualitative.

doubleDescent.description: Possible double-descent pattern, not a curve fitted to notebook results. The notebook may turn upward again at large p.
